g_policy.reason: The card is opt-in ('Play a short game'), the offer copy names the reward (3 chats in Advanced reasoning mode), 'Not now' leaves home unchanged, and the ad-fail and unverified-play paths are both defined.

g_no_cash.reason: The reward is 3 chats in Advanced reasoning mode, which is an in-app feature and has no cash value.

g_no_chat_content.reason: The trigger is an app event, the first open after 3 or more days with no session by a non-subscriber, and needs no chat content.

g_no_free_removal.reason: The proposal removes nothing free ('removes nothing free: yes'), and the model shows Advanced reasoning mode as a paywall feature (l02).

g_brand_safety.reason: The offer is a dismissible card on the Chats home (s01, rated safe), which counts as app chrome, and it is not inside a conversation.

c1_revealed_value.reason: Advanced reasoning mode is listed as a paid Luzia+ feature (s02.e03, l02), so the app charges for the resource the reward gives.

c2_evidence.reason: The claims that Advanced reasoning mode is paid (s02.e03), the badge is on home (s01.e02) and the trial exists (s02.e19) are all observed. The per-chat 'stays in that mode' behavior is flagged as an inference within the reward, which is a design of the reward rather than a claim about the app.

c4_protects_subscription.reason: The reward is limited to 3 chats, so it is a quantity-limited sample, and every other chat and the full feature stay behind Luzia+.

c5_moment.reason: The card sits on the home screen at app open, before the user starts any task, and it is dismissible.

c6_fits_simula.reason: It is a play-to-earn unit. The reward is granted only after the play is confirmed, and the trigger (first open after a 3+ day gap) is an app event the app can detect.

c7_specific.reason: It names Advanced reasoning mode, the Luzia+ badge, the Chats home prompt card and the Weekly/Monthly/Annual paywall, so it could not be dropped into another app unchanged.

other_concern: The model shows no per-chat mode toggle and no free-tier limit, so how a chat 'stays' in Advanced reasoning mode is unverified. The 1-per-day cap is redundant with the 3-day-gap trigger.
